where.zone: in the final third, on the right

angle: Late in stoppage time Segun Okafor picked a low-value pass instead of a shown higher-probability option to Kaito Fujiwara that might have created a clearer chance in a chaotic spell.

explanation.why_it_matters: At 90'+2 with the score NBR 3 HRV 4 and Chaos Index 69, Okafor picked a low-value pass (0.0078) instead of the better option to Kaito Fujiwara (0.0565, 33% success), a -0.0487 DVA that reduced a clearer late chance. In a chaotic spell that spiked to 95 then 84, that choice shifted pressure away from a higher-threat outlet.

en.headline: Late choice costs a chance
en.body: Segun Okafor picked a safe pass instead of a clearer option to Kaito Fujiwara at 90'+2. Northbridge needed something bolder in stoppage time.

it.headline: Una scelta tardiva costa un'occasione
it.body: Segun Okafor ha scelto un passaggio sicuro invece di un'opzione più nitida per Kaito Fujiwara al 90'+2. Il Northbridge avrebbe avuto bisogno di qualcosa di più coraggioso nei minuti di recupero.

es.headline: Una elección tardía cuesta una oportunidad
es.body: Segun Okafor eligió un pase seguro en lugar de una opción más clara hacia Kaito Fujiwara en el 90'+2. Northbridge necesitaba algo más valiente en el tiempo de descuento.

en.body: DVA -0.0487; chosen pass xT 0.0078 vs Kaito Fujiwara option xT 0.0565 with 33% success probability; Chaos Index 69 — a high-risk moment that reduced a clearer chance.
